says: Scene 6: a city of gourd-shaped towers at night, since the architecture is what has been working. Two people stand on a curved balcony of the big building cropped at the right, one pointing out at the city; I sized them against the lit doorway behind them, which is clearly taller than they are, and gave their limbs taper. A walkway bridge crosses to an onion-capped tower on the left, smaller bulbs crowd behind, and a craft cuts a headlight beam across a densely hatched sky, with the moon and stars left as white paper. Graphic darks this time: the night is drawn, and every lit window is reserved white.
